name: low_mode_threshold_step02
purpose: TASKS 218, GoalGathering/notes/PreRegistration_2026-11-20_Low_Mode_Repair_Threshold.md, the two-route check: the smallest sampled molecule of each band (4 molecules, 15-19 atoms) patched again with a step of 0.02 bohr instead of 0.01, same threshold as the sample run, into a folder of its own. probes/low_mode_threshold_read.py --step-check flags a point whose two steps differ by more than 0.15 cm-1 (the agreement recorded at vibrations.STEP_BOHR). The corpus files are only read

estimate.basis: probes/results_m1/low_mode_threshold_2026-11-20/sample/SAMPLE.md: B_0c6c144a7f, B_1726105aae, B_0af11315e3 and B_1428bc8164 at one direction each below 60 cm-1 are 12 + 9 + 9 + 12 = 42 min at 8 threads; 4 threads assumed 1-2 times that (not measured), so 0.7-1.4 h

memory.basis: a bound: probes/wsl_capped.sh stops it at 4096 MB (CAP_MB); the 15-atom check of 12 Nov peaked at 2.52 GB under the same cap
